$comment: Controls what the GitHub sync is allowed to put on the CV and portfolio. Repos not listed here are still synced but are hidden unless INCLUDE_UNLISTED is true.

AgentIde.name: AgentIde
AgentIde.cvDescription: EDR/XDR assessment framework: a Go agent runs EICAR, LOLBin, anti-tamper and boot-gap modules and streams MITRE ATT&CK-scored results to a central dashboard.

ExtSafe.name: ExtSafe
ExtSafe.cvDescription: Browser extension safety auditor that scrapes extension metadata and risk signals, supports review workflows, and exports findings to Excel.

MITM.name: MITM Proxy Shield
MITM.cvDescription: Network-level ad blocking and content filtering platform built on Squid and SquidGuard, with a Flask management API and Chrome MV3 telemetry extensions.

OrangeIntel.name: TealHunt
OrangeIntel.cvDescription: Threat intelligence platform that enriches indicators against VirusTotal and AbuseIPDB and turns them into structured advisory and assessment workflows.

DailyBrief.name: Daily BRIEF
DailyBrief.cvDescription: Daily operations logger with AI-assisted handover generation, multi-user access control, and PDF/CSV/XLSX export.

AssetPulse.name: AssetPulse
AssetPulse.cvDescription: Endpoint compliance platform reconciling hardware inventory against Cortex XDR, Qualys and CrowdStrike telemetry to surface shadow IT and compliance drift.

LinkPass.name: LinkPass
LinkPass.cvDescription: Team-based enterprise password manager with end-to-end encryption, RBAC and mandatory MFA.

RoleHunter.name: RoleHunter
RoleHunter.cvDescription: AI job-hunting automation platform that scans job boards, scores listings against a CV, and sends personalised outreach.

SOCTI-Toolkit.name: SOC Toolkit
SOCTI-Toolkit.cvDescription: Python utility for log ingestion, IOC parsing, alert triage automation, and daily SOC reporting; adopted as a core operational tool by the SOC team.

SOCTI-Web-API.name: SOC Toolkit Web API
SOCTI-Web-API.cvDescription: Web API exposing the SOC toolkit's parsing and enrichment functions for use by other tooling.

browser-extension-control.name: Browser Extension Control
browser-extension-control.cvDescription: Reference implementation for default-deny browser extension governance on managed Chromium endpoints.

pacman-publication.name: PACMAN
pacman-publication.cvDescription: A safe control plane for proxy auto-config (PAC) delivery.

SepX---separator-tool.name: SepX
SepX---separator-tool.cvDescription: Desktop separator tool for inserting delimiters between tokens in arbitrary text.
